'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Paul Schumann DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Schumann]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
